nodes.assumption: The builder knows how to cross BUILDME (move the cursor from TICKETME:waiting to BUILDME and ensure required commits are in place). VOYAGE CRAFT section 1 describes which commits should exist, but the actual command/mechanism to perform the BUILDME crossing is not explicitly stated. By analogy with PROVEME (which uses `cairn.tools.base.cross <ticket id> PROVEME`), the crossing likely uses a similar tool, but this is not stated in the text.
nodes.would_settle: Specify the exact command or tool to perform the BUILDME crossing (e.g., `cairn.tools.base.cross 135a905eac3c BUILDME --actor cc` or similar).
